method: Source/sink-first local static review of first-party HTTP handlers under dockerized_labs, challenge and introduction; scanner review compared only after candidate inventory. No exploit or external requests.

Command Injection.reason: Direct subprocess/shell sinks reviewed; indirect helpers and runtime conditions not exhaustively verified.

SQL Injection.reason: Direct sqlite execute sinks reviewed; ORM and dynamically invoked query paths not exhaustively verified.

Path Traversal.reason: Direct open sinks reviewed; template-loader path behavior and indirect file APIs require follow-up.

SSRF.reason: Direct requests and urllib sinks reviewed; indirect network helpers and runtime settings not exhaustively verified.

Code Execution.reason: Outside current Python command-injection Rule; eval and image-expression semantics need separate evaluation.

Unsafe Deserialization.reason: Outside the four current Python Rules; no safe local execution attempted.

candidates.data_flow: domain is interpolated into dig/nslookup shell command before Popen.
candidates.evidence: No domain validation or shell escaping; both branches execute the constructed command with shell=True.

candidates.data_flow: username and password enter an SQL f-string, then execute without parameter binding.
candidates.evidence: The same file uses bound parameters for a fixed INSERT at line 25, but the login SELECT at line 50 is interpolated.

candidates.data_flow: blog is joined to the source directory, with no containment check, before open.
candidates.evidence: os.path.join does not reject parent components or absolute paths; the handler returns read content.

candidates.data_flow: url passes directly to requests.get with no destination validation.
candidates.evidence: The handler accepts and fetches the supplied URL; no allowlist or private-network check precedes the request.

candidates.data_flow: Unvalidated form expression is passed directly to Python eval.
candidates.evidence: This is Python expression evaluation, not a shell command sink covered by the current Command Injection Rule.

candidates.data_flow: Submitted serialized data is decoded and passed to pickle.loads.
candidates.evidence: No deserialization Rule exists; static source-to-sink flow is present. No pickle payload executed.

candidates.data_flow: Route filename chooses a template path, but Jinja loader containment and URL routing have not been verified.
candidates.evidence: The path is dynamic, but traversal outside the template root is not established; this is not an open() sink.
